_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Training Program Structure Document
summary: Specifies the preparation instructions for the content and format of the Training Program Structure Document, which provides training planning data and training course control data documenting the detailed configuration baseline of a training course.
use_relationship:
The Training Program Structure Document provides training planning data and training course control data. This information is relative to long-range training program resource requirements, for personnel and equipment, and their implementation. This training data product documents the detailed configuration baseline of a training course.

a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the preparation instructions for the content and format of the Training Program Structure Document.

b. This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the performance requirements described by 3.2.5 of MIL-PRF-29612B, and is applicable to the acquisition of training data products. Data product performance evaluation criteria are specified in 4.3.5 of MIL-PRF-29612B.

c. It is not intended that all the requirements contained herein be applied to every program or program phase. Portions of this DID are subject to deletion tailoring depending upon the program phase in which it is applied in the contract. Any individual data requirement contained in this DID is subject to deletion tailoring.

d. This DID supersedes DI-ILSS-81521A.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The format of data contained within this DID is as follows:

children.title: Page-based products
children.content: For which contractor format is acceptable.

children.title: Standard digital data in compliance with the content
children.content: And format requirements specified in the DoD Data Architecture (DDA) and the Defense Data Dictionary System (DDDS).

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Training Program Structure Document shall contain the following:

children.title: Front matter
children.content: The content of front matter shall be in accordance with Appendix A of MIL-PRF-29612B.

children.title: Part 1: Training planning data
children.content: This data shall provide a description of the sources of the training needs and the training strategies to satisfy those needs by course, training program, and Service component for peacetime and mobilization.

children.title: Training concept data
children.content: This data shall contain the following:

children.title: The identification of the documents which provide
children.content: The training program mission needs statements.

children.title: The rationale for the training requirement (e.g.
children.content: New systems, change in occupational specialty structure, change in threat and doctrine, organization and mission changes in training policy, methodology or field performance discrepancies, tasking by higher authority, scheduled course review, surveillance, external feedback resulting from the training appraisal program, Engineering Change Proposals (ECPs)/weapon system change authorizations, changed course length).

children.title: A description of the training strategy for both
children.content: The active and reserve components during peacetime and mobilization, including active and reserve and peacetime and mobilization differences, which includes the status of training for equipment that is being replaced in the active component but utilized in the reserve component. Include the following for resident and nonresident training:

children.title: A description of each skill level or pay
children.content: Grade which explains the training available for active and reserve personnel.

children.title: A description of the courses for specialty skills
children.content: (e.g., Additional Skill Identifier (ASI), Special Qualification Identifier (SQI), Air Force Specialty Code (AFSC), Navy Enlisted Classification (NEC) Code, Navy Officer Billet Classification (NOBC) Code, Military Occupational Specialty (MOS)).

children.title: A description of the training planned for transition
children.content: Or replacement training.

children.title: A description of the training to accomplish occupational
children.content: Skill area merger training.

children.title: A description of the functional courses
A description of the programs and products
children.content: For unit integration and sustainment training.

children.title: The current training which will be deleted by
children.content: The new training program.

children.title: The alternatives to accomplish the training requirement if
children.content: Additional resources required to support the training concept are not provided.

children.title: Impact if development/change/revision is not undertaken
children.content: The impact data shall provide a clear and precise statement of the impact on mission requirements and capabilities if the development/change/revision is not undertaken.

children.title: Milestone chart
children.content: The milestone chart shall provide a time-phased relationship commencing with the earliest lead-time resource requirement through establishment of training capability. Projected start and completion dates for each key event shall be indicated.

children.title: Course milestone schedule
children.content: The schedule shall specify events, length, instructor contact hours, class sizes, Interservice Training Review Organization (ITRO) codes, contract codes, academic hours, and dates of programmed changes. The milestone schedule shall include the following:

children.title: Individual Training Plan (ITP) and course administrative information
children.content: (e.g., ITP name, course titles, numbers, types, dates).

children.title: System related milestones. System identification
children.content: Collective and individual training plan submission date, and first unit equipped dates for each system supported by the ITP.

children.title: Training development resource information (e.g.
children.content: Workload factors in the areas of specialties, programs of instruction, courses).

children.title: Course resource information (e.g.
children.content: Length, hours, size, student input) used for determining resource requirements.

children.title: Resource estimate data
children.content: This data shall provide descriptions of the equipment, ammunition, facility, and funding requirements that are not currently available to the installation. The estimate will be in narrative form and will include fiscal years in which resources will be required. The estimate shall address the following:

children.title: Resource requirements that are not available
Unfinanced requirements in the program years
Manpower requirements not addressed in the milestone schedules
children.content: Or the resource narrative.

children.title: The estimated costs associated with any new
children.content: Or modified training.

children.title: Estimated requirements for all ammunition and related trainers
children.content: Or simulators required for one iteration of each course.

children.title: A resource summary supplement that identifies other requirements
children.content: (e.g., construction, maintenance, repair).

children.title: Follow-on training recommendations
children.content: This data shall provide the contractor's recommendations for any follow-on training program to be conducted in support of the system/equipment. Such recommendations shall include results of any trade studies made to determine cost-effectiveness of various methods of conducting training (current training programs and capabilities may be used as a baseline for the development of this information).

children.title: Part 2: Training course data
children.content: The training course data shall provide descriptions of the training content (e.g., subject, topics, tasks), training material, types and duration of instruction, and resources required to conduct both peacetime and mobilization training, and shall be documented in sections as follows:

children.title: Course accounting
children.content: The course accounting data shall include the following descriptive information:

children.title: Course Identification Number/Production Identification Number/Production Assignment Number (CIN/PIN/PAN)
Prerequisites (i.e.
children.content: A requirement the student must possess before attending the proposed training).

children.title: Instructional strategy (e.g.
children.content: Programmed learning, traditional learning, small group learning, Advanced Distributed Learning (ADL)).

children.title: A breakout of academic training
children.content: Aircrew trainers, and flight hours/sorties by type aircraft.

children.title: The agency from which quotas to the course
children.content: Must be obtained.

children.title: Type training. (Use alphanumeric code; e.g.
children.content: A1, C1.) (See specific Service formal schools catalog of courses for guidance on codes.)

children.title: Location of training. Training locations to include
children.content: The specific school and its geographic location.

children.title: Security requirements (e.g.
children.content: Training equipment, course materials, training space, clearance required to attend).

children.title: Military assistance program articles and service list number
children.content: (This is a seven position alphanumeric code used to identify a course used for foreign military training.)

children.title: Training development proponent school for analysis
children.content: Design, development, and for instructor billets include data for installation, city, state and zip code of the proponent school.

children.title: Course proponent (e.g.
children.content: Office of primary responsibility, course model manager).

children.title: The agency which bears the cost of temporary
children.content: Duty incidental to attendance at the course.

children.title: Those costs that are directly related
children.content: To the course of instruction.

children.title: Requirements for the delivery of ADL products that
children.content: Identify the following:

children.title: Electronic broadcast and transmission specifications applied
Metadata tags which will support courseware object interoperability
children.content: Across platforms and systems, reusability, and Internet protocol compatibility.

children.title: Course administrative data
children.content: Course administrative data, to include data for peacetime and mobilization versions of the course, shall consist of the following:

children.title: Course length to include hours
children.content: Days, and weeks.

children.title: Breakdown of classroom and laboratory hours
Class size
children.content: Include data for maximum, optimum, and minimum class sizes.

children.title: The occupational skill area
children.content: Branch, functional area, Area of Concentration (AOC), Skill, Additional Skill Identifier (ASI), or Special Qualifications Identifier (SQI) for which the course provides qualification on training.

children.title: The specific target audience for which the course
children.content: Is designed.

children.title: Course code (e.g.
children.content: Course type code, ITRO code, contract code, Marine Corps Service School Codes (MCO P1080.20, JUMPS/MMS Codes Manual) other Service number).

children.title: Academic hours that include a breakout of course
children.content: Unique, shared, contracted, and conducted per week; and a breakout of practical application, performance evaluation, and written examination conducted per week.

children.title: Additional information essential for selection of students (i.e.
children.content: Special approval), preparation of orders (i.e., course length), or for explaining a course's phases.

children.title: A list of environmental and hazardous materials
A list of high risk/safety issues
Course training standards
children.content: The course training standards data shall include the following information:

children.title: Standards of accomplishment for each element
Instructional media data
children.content: (Media are the delivery vehicles used to present instructional material or basic sensory stimulus presented to a student to induce learning. In other words, the means used to give information to the students.) This data shall include a description of, and identifiers for the following:

children.title: Film strips (e.g.
children.content: Silent, pre-narrated).

children.title: Electronic job aids (e.g.
children.content: Templates, macros).

children.title: Trainers. This data shall include descriptions
children.content: Of the trainer requirements, mission statement and objective, and an explanation of the sortie/exercise elements to be trained using the following trainers:

children.title: Combination platform and component and simulator (hybrid trainers)
On-line (e.g.
children.content: Internet, intranet, extranet) courses including:

children.title: Web-ready (e.g.
children.content: Hypertext Markup Language (HTML), Extensible Markup Language (XML), synchronous, etc.).

children.title: Web-deliverable (i.e.
children.content: Executable files launched via a browser).

children.title: Web-based (i.e.
children.content: Asynchronous and synchronous instruction).

children.title: Web-downloadable (i.e.
children.content: Content for off-line instruction).

children.title: Compact Disk-Read Only Memory (CD-ROM)
children.content: Digital Versatile Disk (DVD), and other digital storage devices.

children.title: Operational training
children.content: This data shall include the following information:

children.title: Special instructions and restrictions on operational training
Explanation of sorties/exercises (e.g.
children.content: Time, number).

children.title: Course learning objectives
children.content: This data shall include a listing of Terminal Learning Objectives (TLOs) taught in the course.

children.title: Explanation of terms
children.content: The explanation of terms shall include terms unique to the training command or training system.

children.title: Curriculum outline of instruction
children.content: The outline shall provide detailed training data for each lesson. The outline shall provide the sequence in which the instruction is to be presented and shall contain the following:

children.title: Purpose (brief statement of purpose of the lesson)
Lesson title
children.content: Scope, and designator.

children.title: Academic hours by type of instruction (e.g.
children.content: Peacetime, mobilization, practical exercise, exam, integrated or not integrated).

children.title: Training tasks
children.content: Subjects, conditions, standards, numbers, supporting activity, and whether the lesson teaches identified training tasks to a standard.

children.title: An identification of other documentation required
children.content: For the performance of a specific training task, item, or function.

children.title: School director's name
children.content: Signature, and date line.

children.title: Training annexes (e.g.
children.content: Mandatory, examination, common core) with groupings of learning objectives.

children.title: Time allotments in hours for each section
children.content: Topic of instruction, specific lesson or module, or Program of Instruction file.

children.title: Course summary and presentation schedule
children.content: The summary and schedule shall contain an outline of each major section or topic of instruction within the training course and the following:

children.title: Academic time for all annexes or areas (classified
children.content: And unclassified), including lecture, conference, discussion, practical application, performance evaluation, written examination.

children.title: Administrative time (e.g.
children.content: In-processing, out-processing, physical fitness training, commandant's, open, excluded, graduation, inspections).

children.title: Classroom and practical application time to include hours
children.content: And percentage of total time.

children.title: Total time allocated for each topic of instruction
Scheduled order of presentation to include hourly
children.content: Daily, and weekly program for the entire course.

children.title: Separate schedule listings for classroom
children.content: Training equipment, and laboratory use.

children.title: ADL training portal and facilities scheduling for support
children.content: Of synchronous and asynchronous on-line and off-line instructor and student participation requirements.

children.title: Recommended lesson sequence of instruction by day
children.content: For each Program of Instruction file number (lesson), and the number of hours.

children.title: Individual training standards
children.content: This data shall provide a list of Individual Training Standards (ITS) included in this course.

children.title: Profile item-to-topic objective assignment chart
children.content: This chart shall provide a cross-reference between the Personnel Performance Profile (PPP) items or training task numbers and the corresponding lesson plan locations for presenting the PPP items or training task numbers, learning objectives, test items, and an index of lesson file numbers.

children.title: Fault applicability list
children.content: This list shall provide a description of all planned equipment faults, to include prefaulted modules, approved for use in the course to support the LOs.

children.title: Resource requirements list
children.content: This list shall provide descriptions of equipment, equipment refurbishment, publications, audiovisual aids, training material, facilities, and personnel required for conducting the course. The items shall be classified as either Government Furnished Equipment (GFE) or Contractor Furnished Equipment (CFE) and shall be listed separately. The amounts required for expendable and non-expendable materials shall be included. The information on resources required to conduct training shall include the following:

children.title: Those billets required to operate the school
children.content: Other than instructors and instructor supervisors, for this course.

children.title: A statement regarding availability of government billeting
A statement regarding availability of government messing
A description of all facilities or ranges required
children.content: To conduct one iteration of the resident training program, without regard to the location or availability of facilities, and shall include the following:

children.title: The type of special purpose classrooms or facilities
children.content: Unit of measure, and number of units.

children.title: The number of hours of facility usage required
children.content: Per student for both peacetime and mobilization.

children.title: Internet
children.content: Intranet, extranet connection requirements.

children.title: Infrastructure requirements unique to courses presented in
children.content: An ADL environment (e.g., Internet, intranet, bandwidth, hardware, software, LMS, CMS, courseware development/authoring tools, communications tools, resource references).

children.title: The ammunition (e.g.
children.content: Live, dummy, inert, trainers, simulators) requirements include the following:

children.title: Quantity requirement for peacetime and mobilization
children.content: And the distribution requirement per student, per class, and the ratio.

children.title: The operational equipment requirements (any equipment required
children.content: For an operational mission used in support of the training course) include the following:

children.title: Number (e.g.
children.content: Line item number, national stock number).

children.title: Quantity requirement for peacetime and mobilization
children.content: The distribution requirement per student, per class, and the average equipment-to-student ratio.

children.title: Training aids
children.content: Trainers, and substitute requirements for peacetime and mobilization, include the following:

children.title: Number (e.g.
children.content: Line item number, national stock number, trainer number, part number).

children.title: Quantity requirement for peacetime and mobilization
children.content: And the distribution requirement per student, per class, and the ratio.

children.title: Prioritized ammunition conservation measures during mobilization
Part number and nomenclature of equipment that is
children.content: Replaced/substituted.

children.title: The description of any substituted item
children.content: Quantity, and cost for nonstandard equipment and range usage during mobilization.

children.title: Miscellaneous items (i.e.
children.content: Requirements which do not fall under any of the above listed categories).
